name: Website Mockup Template
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Website Mockup Template is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you create and preview stylish website mockups directly from your WordPress dashboard. You can upload multiple gallery images, set custom image width and height, and customize the background using a color or an image. The plugin provides a simple, visual interface to help you present website mockups or layout ideas quickly and clearly.

Key Features – Website Mockup Template

  • Shortcode Integration: Use [wbmckuptmp_mockup] to display your mockup on any page or post.
  • Customizable Content: Set a background color or upload a background image.
  • Image Gallery Support: Upload up to 5 images to display within your mockup.
  • Responsive Layout: CSS-based flexible layout ensures your mockup displays correctly on all devices.
  • Lightweight & Easy to Use: Designed for simplicity and smooth performance within WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/website-mockup-template directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Website Mockup Template > Settings in your WordPress dashboard to upload images, adjust image width and height, and customize the mockup background color or background image.
  4. Add the shortcode [wbmckuptmp_mockup] to any page or post to display the mockup.
sections.faq:
Can I display multiple mockups with different settings?

Currently, the plugin uses a single global setting for displaying mockups. You can use the [wbmckuptmp_mockup] shortcode, and it will display the same configured mockup.

Can I leave some image fields empty?

Yes. You can upload as many or as few images as you like — the mockup will display only the uploaded ones. You can add up to 5 images in total.

Can I customize image sizes and background?

Yes. You can set custom gallery image width and height (in rem), and also customize the mockup background with a color or background image.
